gloss: fusuma painting; painting on sliding doors

definitions.gloss: fusuma painting; painting on sliding doors
definitions.explanation: A picture painted on the paper surface of {襖|ふすま} (sliding interior doors), a traditional form of Japanese decorative art seen in temples, castles, and old residences.

examples.japanese: {襖絵|ふすまえ}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する。
この{寺|てら}には{有名|ゆうめい}な{襖絵|ふすまえ}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: This temple still has famous fusuma paintings.

examples.japanese: {金箔|きんぱく}を{使|つか}った{豪華|ごうか}な{襖絵|ふすまえ}が{客間|きゃくま}を{飾|かざ}っている。
examples.english: Gorgeous gold-leaf fusuma paintings decorate the reception room.

notes:
Painting done directly on {襖|ふすま} panels. Major works survive in temples and castles and are often important cultural properties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {襖絵|ふすまえ}を{描|えが}く: to paint a fusuma painting
- {襖絵|ふすまえ}を{修復|しゅうふく}する: to restore a fusuma painting
- {金地|きんじ}の{襖絵|ふすまえ}: a gold-ground fusuma painting

RELATED WORDS:
- {襖|ふすま}: sliding interior door (paper-covered)
- {屏風絵|びょうぶえ}: folding-screen painting
